section_summary.extract_value: This section presents path analysis results examining whether self-reassurance and body appreciation mediate the associations between social safeness and eating-related psychopathology dimensions (restraint, eating concern, weight concern, and shape concern) while controlling for BMI. The final model demonstrated excellent fit and revealed that social safeness had both direct and indirect effects on body appreciation and eating psychopathology outcomes, with self-reassurance and body appreciation serving as significant mediators. The analysis used the BAS-2 (Body Appreciation Scale-II) to assess body appreciation.
